description: Look up a company directory profile by its stable co_ ID. Deep adds legal/reference details and selected description, logo, domains, social_profiles (platform, url, handle), phone_numbers and email_addresses (with source-reported type), founding precision, reported employees and field-level sources when available. Employee counts retain their measurement date, organization scope and approximation flag; null means unknown. A website claim is not legal ownership proof. National registration numbers use company.

deep.description: Include the nested deep object when available. Pricing depends on the operation.

id.description: Stable company directory ID returned by company_search
